fusions.name: Spooked Stampede
fusions.desc: Stampedes through everything around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles. You ride it out, moving 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Gathering Charge
fusions.desc: Gores a target for 30 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Rally the Troop
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Grazer

riders.text: the ground goes by a little faster
and you get your breath back between things
and you are gone before the horn arrives

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 4% faster, from silver your stamina comes back 12% faster, and from gold you have 5% more dodge chance.
